info.desc: Green is the sixth studio album by the American alternative rock band R.E.M., released in November 1988. As its debut album for Warner Bros. Records, the band continued to explore political issues both in the album's lyrics and packaging. To promote Green, the band embarked on an 11 month world tour and released four singles: "Orange Crush", "Stand", "Pop Song 89", and "Get Up". .

podcast.body: "Green" was R.E.M.'s first album released on Warner Brothers, a major record label, after their significant move from indie label IRS Records. The album was symbolically important because it demonstrated that a college rock indie band could transition to a major label without compromising their music, art, or integrity. Its title was theorized to be a humorous nod to their major label signing. "The Green album was hugely important in a symbolic sense. It showed that it was possible for a college rock indie band to work for a major without selling their music, their art, and their integrity."

podcast.body: Released in 1988, this was R.E.M.'s sixth album and their first as a major label band after five independent releases. It performed well, reaching the top 20 in Canada, the US, and Australia, and the top 30 in the UK, setting high expectations for its follow-up. "This was the follow-up to 1998's Green album, which was their first record as a major label band."

podcast.body: This album is widely regarded as the first installment in R.E.M.'s "great trilogy" of albums released with Warner Music. This collection of works is considered one of the best trilogies in the history of US music, signifying a new era for the band after their departure from IRS Records. "sería el green, el out of time y el automátil, for the people."

podcast.body: This album was R.E.M.'s first release after signing with Warner Brothers. The band named the album "Green" as a subtle, humorous nod to their perceived "selling out" by moving to a major label, while still maintaining creative control. "Why do you think that first record for Warner Brothers is called Green?"
